author: Khan Academy
description:
Some districts are banning AI outright. West Hempstead UFSD went the other direction — deliberately, with guardrails, and with a clear line about what belongs in elementary school and what doesn't.

In this 47-minute conversation, Sal Khan asks Superintendent Dan Rehman and his teachers the uncomfortable questions: screen time, cheating, cognitive offloading, and whether any of this is appropriate for young children.

0:00 Welcome and Introductions
2:58 Why Implementation Matters More Than the Software
3:51 ROI vs. ROL: Measuring "Return on Learning"
5:06 How Khanmigo Makes Student Reasoning Visible
6:57 NY's Portrait of a Graduate and Personalized Pacing
8:33 Grade 2: Turning Screener Data into Targeted Practice
9:31 Grade 5: Meeting Every Learner in a Co-Taught Classroom
11:25 Supporting ENL and Multilingual Learners
12:10 Keeping Great Instruction at the Center
12:53 Grade 7 Math: Helping Students Find What They Don't Know
14:52 Teacher Productivity: Making the Renaissance Relevant
title: From ROI to "Return on Learning": A District's Khan Academy Story
